subject.title: vllm openai-completions streaming parser drops tool_calls when reasoning_content streams first for gpt-oss-120b at large systemPrompt

question: Should OpenClaw require exact current-main vLLM gpt-oss stream proof before accepting any recovery that could reclassify assistant text as executable tool calls?
rationale: The safe fix depends on whether maintainers want only a fixture-backed parser repair or are willing to sponsor provider-specific recovery before the exact stream is captured; that choice affects the tool-execution boundary.

options.title: Require exact stream proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

options.title: Sponsor vLLM-specific recovery
options.body: Allow a maintainer-owned provider-specific recovery design with tests that prove false text-to-tool promotion cannot execute ordinary assistant text.

options.title: Defer to docs workaround
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the documented vLLM tool_choice workaround is enough for this deployment class despite the structured-wire evidence.

recommendation.title: Require exact stream proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a redacted current-main SSE fixture or live vLLM gpt-oss reproduction proves the failure, then fix only that parser path.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history in the OpenAI-compatible reasoning/tool-call stream parser surface.
